features.name: Arcane Initiate
features.desc: You learn two cantrips from the Wizard spell list (they count as Cleric cantrips for you).

features.name: Spell Breaker
features.desc: When you restore Hit Points with a healing spell, you can also cast Dispel Magic on the target without expending a spell slot.

features.name: Arcane Mastery
features.desc: You gain Resistance to damage from spells.
